cold.required_protocol: Cold is produced, not assumed: each job runs on a freshly provisioned VM (no reuse between jobs), and each timed cold index is preceded by `sync && sudo sysctl -w vm.drop_caches=3`. Warm figures are the same process's later invocations over the store the cold pass built. The Go build and module caches are populated by actions/setup-go BEFORE any measurement, so compilation never falls inside a measured window.
